materials.title: Provided CSDIY Data100 catalog snapshot
materials.use: Provenance and high-level scope only; not instructional course content.

blocked.reason: The snapshot says only 'refer to the course website' and supplies neither assignment bodies nor direct assignment URLs.
blocked.impact: No official assignment can be identified, ordered, or included in this kickoff.
blocked.resolution: A later authorized retrieval job must locate, verify, and record each public assignment independently.

blocked.reason: The snapshot contains no syllabus, lecture sequence, semester, or dependency structure.
blocked.impact: Later units cannot be honestly ordered as official Data100 units from this snapshot alone.
blocked.resolution: Retrieve and provenance-pin a public official schedule before expanding the official graph.

blocked.reason: The current preparation is bounded to the supplied snapshot; the two URLs were recorded but not opened.
blocked.impact: Their current reachability, contents, license terms, and version are unverified.
blocked.resolution: Use a later harness-authorized retrieval job if those bodies are needed.

requirements: Retrieve only public, permitted content without authentication bypass or access-control circumvention.
Record the requested URL, final URL, retrieval result, retrieval time, content hash, and applicable license or usage evidence.
Keep link discovery distinct from content availability and from official-unit classification.
Preserve failed or unavailable retrieval records rather than inventing content or silently promoting a pointer.
Re-run graph classification and harness validation after adding material.

validation.label: UNVALIDATED_AVAILABILITY_INVENTORY
validation.meaning: Availability reflects only the supplied snapshot and locally prepared files.
